description: Bauchi Voter Pulse core schema v2 (executable). v1 questions unchanged + language (EN/HA/mixed/other) so per-language accuracy and review rates can be measured. One Jev call answers all 6 in parallel.

intensity.instructions: How strong is the emotional intensity of this post? Rate from calm (factual reporting, no emotional language) through mild and moderate (some feeling, adjectives) to strong (heated language, blame or praise) and very_strong (outrage or euphoria, extreme wording, calls to action).

criteria.english: Written in English; names of people or places in another language do not count
criteria.mixed: Mixes Hausa and English in the same post
criteria.other: Written mainly in another language, for example Arabic or Fulfulde

language.instructions: What language is this post written in? Judge by the words actually used in the post.

criteria.Alkaleri: Mentions Alkaleri town, Gwana, or Alkaleri LGA issues
criteria.Bauchi: Mentions Bauchi city, the state capital, or Bauchi LGA
criteria.Bogoro: Mentions Bogoro or Bogoro LGA issues
criteria.Dambam: Mentions Dambam or Dambam LGA issues
criteria.Darazo: Mentions Darazo or Darazo LGA issues
criteria.Dass: Mentions Dass or Dass LGA issues
criteria.Gamawa: Mentions Gamawa or Gamawa LGA issues
criteria.Ganjuwa: Mentions Ganjuwa, Kafin Madaki, or Ganjuwa LGA issues
criteria.Giade: Mentions Giade or Giade LGA issues
criteria.Itas-Gadau: Mentions Itas, Gadau, or Itas-Gadau LGA issues
criteria.Jamaare: Mentions Jamaare or Jamaare LGA issues
criteria.Katagum: Mentions Azare, Katagum, or Katagum LGA issues
criteria.Kirfi: Mentions Kirfi or Kirfi LGA issues
criteria.Misau: Mentions Misau or Misau LGA issues
criteria.Ningi: Mentions Ningi or Ningi LGA issues
criteria.Shira: Mentions Shira, Yana, or Shira LGA issues
criteria.Tafawa-Balewa: Mentions Tafawa Balewa, Bununu, or Tafawa-Balewa LGA issues
criteria.Toro: Mentions Toro or Toro LGA issues
criteria.Warji: Mentions Warji or Warji LGA issues
criteria.Zaki: Mentions Zaki, Katagum-area Zaki, or Zaki LGA issues

lga_relevance.instructions: Which Bauchi State LGA is this post most relevant to? Judge ONLY by place names, events, or local issues named in the text. Pick the single best match.

criteria.false: No mention of Yakubu Adamu or APM; the post is about other politicians, parties, or general topics only
criteria.true: Names Yakubu Adamu in any spelling, or mentions APM or the APM Bauchi campaign

mentions_candidate.instructions: The text mentions Dr. Yakubu Adamu or the APM campaign.

criteria.false: No sign of PDP or APC partisanship; APM supporter, neutral observer, or unclear leaning
criteria.true: Praises PDP or APC candidates, repeats PDP or APC talking points, or attacks APM from a PDP or APC partisan angle

opposition_signal.instructions: The post appears to originate from a PDP or APC sympathizer.

criteria.negative: Criticizes, attacks, mocks, or opposes Yakubu Adamu or APM
criteria.neutral: Mentions Yakubu Adamu or APM factually, without praise or criticism
criteria.not_about_candidate: The post is not about Yakubu Adamu or the APM campaign at all
criteria.positive: Praises, supports, endorses, or defends Yakubu Adamu or APM

sentiment.instructions: What sentiment does this post express toward Dr. Yakubu Adamu or the APM Bauchi campaign?
